jobs.description_html:
Every search represents someone seeking reliable information. They depend on search results being accurate, trustworthy, and relevant to their local context. But search engines only learn to return trustworthy information if human evaluators with deep research expertise and cultural knowledge verify and correct them. Your linguistic precision, fact-checking rigor, and understanding of how your culture communicates and values information is irreplaceable in building search systems that people can actually trust.

 

In this role, you will evaluate search queries, results, and AI-generated content for factual accuracy, authority, relevance, and user intent alignment. Your judgment determines whether search systems return trustworthy, contextually appropriate information.

 

  • Analyze multi-turn search queries and web results for factual accuracy, source authority, and user intent alignment
  • Conduct cross-referencing and fact-checking using regional sources, specialized databases, academic resources, and web directories
  • Assess localized content relevancy across diverse domains—news, sports, local culture, technical queries considering regional context and cultural nuance
  • Evaluate AI-generated content for factual grounding, hallucination risk, and contextual appropriateness
  • Provide structured assessments that train search ranking and content relevance models

 

Qualifications to succeed in this project:

 

  • Professional fluency in English
  • Residency in the United States for the last 3 consecutive years  
  • Active use of Gmail and other forms of social media and experience in the use of web browsers to navigate and interact with a variety of content
  • Deep local cultural awareness and familiarity with regional news, current events, and contemporary culture
  • Strong fact-checking and critical thinking abilities
  • Access to a stable broadband internet, a reliable computer and a smartphone (Android 5.0, iOS 14 or higher)
  • Linguists, cross-cultural researchers, domain specialists, and detail-driven professionals with strong research methodology (preferred)

 

Why join the project:

 

  • Fully remote flexibility: Structure your contributions around research, consulting, teaching, or other professional commitments without rigid scheduling
  • Comprehensive research support: Access detailed evaluation guidelines, reference materials, databases, and resources for fact-checking across domains
  • Quality recognition: Performance assessments focused on consistency, fact-checking precision, and nuanced judgment
  • Intellectually demanding by design: If you are driven by fact-checking precision, source authority analysis, and the challenge of identifying what makes information truly trustworthy, this work is built for that mindset.
  • Responsive support: Direct access to evaluation support staff for clarification on ambiguous queries or technical guidance
  Qualification path

How to get started:

  • Complete your contributor profile and application
  • Take a qualification assessment at your own pace within the time given
  • Verify your identity through our secure identity verification process
  • Acceptance form & Rater Academy: Complete an acceptance form and approximately 2.5 hours of Rater Academy training
  • Receive your project assignment and access credentials

 

Service Rates 

The rate of pay is 0.2333 USD per task, with an estimated earning potential of 14 USD per hour.

Compensation is based on tasks completed and project availability. Estimated earnings may vary depending on task volume and program requirements including, quality, and productivity, in accordance with the program's quality standards and guidelines.

 

Independent Contractor Relationship

This opportunity is offered on an independent contractor basis. Contributors have the flexibility to choose when and how much they work, subject to project availability and quality requirements. This opportunity is not and should not be construed as creating an employment relationship with TELUS Digital.

Mitre Media is redefining FinTech with AI-driven tools that empower millions of investors. Our portfolio, including Dividend.com and MutualFunds.com, leverages LLMs to deliver novel data insights and visually rich user experiences. For over a decade, we’ve served individual investors, financial advisors, and top asset managers like BlackRock and Vanguard through our premium data, tools, and advertising solutions. Join our lean, entrepreneurial team to shape the future of AI-powered investing from your location ±3 hours from Eastern Time.

Our users are deeply engaged, spending over 5 minutes per visit with a bounce rate below 10%, researching investments across hundreds of different categories. With 40 million brokerage accounts in the U.S., we take pride in building tools that make a real impact, fostering a culture of trust, innovation, and dynamism. If you’re passionate about financial technology and AI, we’d love to connect!

As a Full-Stack Rails Tech Lead, you’ll architect and implement LLM-powered web applications within our microservices-based Rails 8 platform. Reporting directly to our CTO, you’ll collaborate with a small, high-impact team to deliver user experiences across Dividend.com, MutualFunds.com and other brands within our portfolio. This role combines expert Ruby on Rails skills with AI integration expertise, requiring you to leverage LLMs in your development workflow, state management and user interactions.

You’ll work in a remote-first hybrid environment, which encourages in person collaboration, using ShapeUp to manage projects that trade-off on-time delivery for de-scoped outcomes.   • Optimize LLM inference for low latency and cost, using caching and asynchronous processing.

Back-End

Front-End

Nice-to-Have Technical Skills

  • Impactful Work: Build AI-powered tools that help millions of investors make informed decisions from data-driven insights.

Metics Media is a small, fully remote team creating high-quality YouTube videos about software, digital marketing, and AI tools for an audience of over 700,000 subscribers. Our mission is simple: to make technology easy to understand and help people get the most out of the tools available to them.

We partner with leading platforms like Shopify, Hostinger, and Squarespace, allowing us to keep our content free and accessible to everyone.

We're now looking for talented, motivated content creators to join our growing team, help us produce even more high-quality videos, and reach millions more people around the world.


What you'll do
  • Research each video's topic and tools in depth, and figure out what to cover and how to present it in a clear, engaging way.
  • Write video scripts and outlines.
  • Record videos, including talking-head and screen recordings. Your face will be visible in your videos.

What we're looking for
  • Native-level written and spoken English
  • Strong on-camera presentation skills and the ability to communicate clearly and confidently

  • A quiet, dedicated workspace where you can work without interruptions, with room to set up a small studio for recording talking-head videos with minimal background noise
  • Fast internet connection with at least 50 Mbps download and 25 Mbps upload
  • Legal authorization to work in the US or Canada


Nice to have
  • Previous experience creating educational video content
  • Knowledge of topics such as website creation, AI tools, ecommerce, or other areas we regularly create videos about
  • Equipment needed to produce high-quality videos


Working at Metics Media

At Metics Media, you'll have a lot of freedom in how you work. You'll be trusted to structure your own day, manage your projects independently, and take ownership of your work. Role Overview:

  • Prescription Fulfillment: Coordinate with participating pharmacies to ensure the correct application of benefits during prescription filling, ensuring patients pay the reduced amount.

If you like wild growth and working with happy, enthusiastic over-achievers, you'll enjoy your career with us!

What we’re looking for

  • Strong proficiency in React, Next.js, TypeScript/JavaScript.

  • Hands-on experience with AWS for production workloads.

  • Solid understanding of web security best practices (OWASP, secure storage, encryption in transit/at rest, secrets management).

  • Experience building systems in or adjacent to healthcare, education, or compliance-heavy environments is a plus.

  • Excellent async communication, code ownership, and ability to work with a small, senior-led team.

  • Comfort working from a clear product brief and also proposing improvements proactively.

  • Familiarity with logging, monitoring, and observability tools.

Take-home assignment (Step 1 of the process)

Please complete a take-home assignment. You are allowed to use LLMs to write code. To ensure that your work will not be used at Fluence, we’ve made it unrelated to healthcare:

Build “LendLoop”: a neighborhood tool-lending board with automated workflows

A simple app where neighbors list tools they are willing to lend, request to borrow from each other, and receive automated notifications and reminders handled by n8n.

Stack

  • Next.js (App Router)

  • Clerk for authentication

  • Convex for data + backend logic

  • n8n (self-hosted via Docker or n8n Cloud) for workflow automation

  • TypeScript

Requirements

Public page

  • The fictional company name is LendLoop.

  • Short tagline, e.g. “Borrow what you need. Lend what you don’t.”

  • Show:

  • A “Sign in to lend or borrow” button wired to Clerk.

Authenticated experience

  • Only signed-in users can:

  • List a tool with:

  • name

  • category (power tools, garden, kitchen, camping, etc.)

  • condition

  • short description

  • Request to borrow a tool for a date range.

  • Approve or decline requests on their own tools.

  • Mark a loan as returned.

  • Show:

  • All tools with availability status, filterable by category.

  • “My listings”, “My requests”, and “Incoming requests” views.

  • Nice, minimal layout.

Roles & rules

  • admin:

  • user:

    • Can create, edit, and delete only their own listings, and act only on requests involving their own tools or their own borrowing.

  • Implement the above role-based access control with best practices, enforced in Convex functions, not only in the UI.

We’re building in a legacy industry and moving gigawatt-hours of electrons in the real world, but we operate at lightning speed, and we’re growing the team to meet customer demand.

We’re proud to be supported by world-leading investors, including Energize Capital and Accel.

Read more about what we’re building here.

We’re looking for a commercially sharp, highly autonomous operator to drive Axle’s commercial success in the German market.

Axle has quickly become the leader in our operational markets, and we’re now looking to expand our reach internationally. Our goal is to become the go-to platform for energy flexibility globally, and we’re hiring the person to make that happen.

This role will assess Axle’s participation in German markets and business models from first principles: diving deep into regulations, modelling revenue-per-asset, and trialling new propositions at pace.

You speak German and fluent English. Other European languages are also an asset.

What you will be doing

  • Owning Axle’s commercial results in the German market: pipeline, revenue and partner success

  • Winning new customers end-to-end, from first conversation through to commercial close, and setting partners up to generate meaningful revenue

  • Driving go-to-market execution with partners, including value propositions, pricing, customer segmentation and launch strategy

  • Building the zero-to-one of the business through partnerships. You’ll be on the phone (and on the ground) with utilities/retailers, potential clients and grid operators, creating and disproving hypotheses as quickly as possible

  • Continuing to sharpen our view of where the value is and which markets and business models are accessible to us

  • Building lasting relationships with grid operators and the regulator, so that Axle is well positioned as the market evolves

  • Acting as the conduit between partners and engineering, creating fast, structured feedback loops that turn field insights into product improvements

As such, we are looking for a “full-stack operator” who can process highly technical information, ramp up commercial value, and accelerate us into new markets.

You might have previous experience in one or more of the activities above, but we are more interested in your growth potential than your domain-specific expertise. We are looking for people who have built things, developed new relationships, and helped get big projects over the line in complex environments.

This is an opportunity to repeatedly deliver first-of-a-kind projects across the world, become a domain expert, and work at the bleeding edge of global electrification.

What’s in it for you

This is a 12 month fixed-term contract. Compensation is highly competitive and dependent on experience.

Bi-annual retreats to strengthen team connection & shared purpose.

The opportunity to directly shape the future of energy markets and accelerate the transition to a low-carbon world.

JustPlay is looking for a Finance Controller Lead (all genders) to join our growing Finance team. Over the past years, we've grown significantly, and we're now backed by NCSoft as our strategic shareholder, with ambitious plans to keep growing. As we scale, our finance function needs to scale with us, and we're looking for a Lead Finance Controller who owns the numbers that steer our business and leads our controlling function: shareholder reporting, budget and forecast, and the KPIs leadership relies on every week. You will report directly to the Associate Director of Finance, be the finance partner for our core revenue and cost drivers, and help build a controlling function that scales with the company.

Job responsibilities

  • Shareholder reporting (NCSoft): Deliver the monthly management P&L and the quarterly consolidated balance sheet and P&L on time and in the shareholder's templates. Provide preliminary figures within a few days of month-end. Keep a clean bridge between management P&L and statutory figures.

  • Budget and forecast: Own the annual budget and a rolling forecast. Turn the overhead budget into a working budget-control process, with cost-center owners, monthly actual-vs-budget reviews and follow-up actions.

  • Business partnering: Be the finance counterpart for Revenue Generation / Ad Monetisation, User Acquisition, User Payments (payouts and rewards) and the G&A cost centers, with profitability as the focus.

  • Cost control: Build levers and tracking for the largest cost blocks: personnel, SaaS, cloud, consulting, and payment fees (PayPal, FX).

  • Analysis: Run variance analysis against budget, forecast and weekly flash, build scenario models, and prepare quarterly business reviews.

  • Data integrity: Establish Metabase/Looker as a reliable source of finance KPIs. Reconcile BI data against invoices and the ledger, own the KPI definitions and remove double counts and manual add-ons.

  • Liquidity: Work with Treasury on the liquidity forecast (network payout timing, UA spend, user cash-outs).

  • Interface with accounting: Work with the Accounting Lead on the in-house month-end close, including accruals input, cut-off, and cost center and chart of accounts design in DATEV.

  • Team: Lead and review the work of our junior FP&A team member as a lead

Job requirements

  • 6+ years in controlling or FP&A, with at least 2 years in a scale-up or digital B2C business; mobile apps, gaming or ad-tech is strongly preferred.

  • Experience leading, mentoring and developing a finance team, helping others grow while setting high standards

  • Proven experience reporting to a corporate or strategic shareholder or a PE owner, including multi-entity consolidation and delivering to external templates under deadline.

  • End-to-end ownership of a full budget and forecast cycle, including building driver-based models.

  • Self-sufficient with data: hands-on with a BI tool (Metabase/Looker) and advanced Excel/Google Sheets

  • Solid accounting foundation (accruals, FX, revenue recognition), with enough IFRS/HGB knowledge to reconcile management and statutory figures.

  • Fluent English (written and verbal). German is a strong plus, given our work with PwC, DATEV and the local entities.

  • Hands-on experience with DATEV, Moss or Embat

  • Experience building a controlling function or KPI governance from scratch

  • Familiarity with multi-currency (USD/EUR) payment flows and FX effects

jobs.description_html:
Bielefeld oder remote innerhalb Deutschlands · Vollzeit oder Teilzeit

Über U-ROB

U-ROB gehört zu den etablierten Full-Service-Anbietern für Drohnenlösungen. Wir bringen Drohnen in den echten Einsatz. Dafür arbeiten wir mit mobilen Drohnen wie der DJI FlyCart 100, der DJI Matrice 5T und der Matrice 400, mit autonomen Dock-Systemen und mit intelligenter Flugsoftware. Außerdem entwickeln wir Detektionslösungen für die jeweiligen Bedrohungsszenarien unserer Kunden.

Wir sind ein schlagkräftiges Team. In dieser Rolle stehen die sorgfältige fachliche Begleitung komplexer Genehmigungsprojekte, die verlässliche Kundenbetreuung und die Organisation unserer Trainings im Mittelpunkt.

Worum es geht

Der Schwerpunkt dieser Position liegt im Genehmigungsmanagement für komplexe Drohneneinsätze. Du prüfst anspruchsvolle Einsatzvorhaben unter technischen, rechtlichen und operativen Rahmenbedingungen und stimmst die Anforderungen und Lösungswege eng mit unseren Kunden ab.

Du entwickelst genehmigungsfähige Betriebskonzepte, erstellst die erforderlichen Antrags- und Nachweisunterlagen und reichst sie bei den jeweils zuständigen Landes- und regionalen Luftfahrtbehörden ein. Rückfragen und Anpassungen begleitest du bis zur Entscheidung.

Daneben betreust du unsere Kunden rund um regelmäßig stattfindende Trainings zur Betriebskategorie „speziell“ und zu konkreten Drohnenlösungen. Du koordinierst Termine, Teilnehmende, Trainer, Unterlagen und Nachweise.

Hier kommen Technik, Recht und praktische Anwendung zusammen. Du arbeitest dich detailliert in Einsatzszenarien, technische Systeme und regulatorische Vorgaben ein, bewertest auch anspruchsvolle fachliche Fragestellungen selbstständig und überführst sie in fundierte, nachvollziehbare Unterlagen und umsetzbare Lösungen.

Was dich erwartet

  • Du prüfst und strukturierst komplexe Genehmigungsprojekte für professionelle Drohneneinsätze

  • Du analysierst Einsatzszenarien, technische Systeme, Betriebsbedingungen und rechtliche Vorgaben und entwickelst daraus genehmigungsfähige Betriebskonzepte

  • Du stimmst Anforderungen und Lösungswege eng mit unseren Kunden ab und übersetzt technische und operative Details in belastbare Antragsunterlagen

  • Du erstellst Anträge und Nachweise, reichst sie bei den zuständigen Landes- und regionalen Luftfahrtbehörden ein und bearbeitest Rückfragen bis zur Entscheidung

  • Du betreust Kunden rund um unsere regelmäßig stattfindenden Trainings und beantwortest fachliche und organisatorische Fragen

  • Du koordinierst Termine, Teilnehmende, Trainer, Schulungsunterlagen und Nachweise, pflegst die zugehörigen Vorgänge und hältst offene Punkte nach

  • Du führst ausgewählte Schulungen und Workshops selbst durch und vermittelst technische, rechtliche und praktische Inhalte verständlich

Was du mitbringst

  • Du begeisterst dich für Drohnen und bringst ein fundiertes technisches Verständnis für komplexe Systeme und Einsatzszenarien mit

  • Du hast Erfahrung mit anspruchsvollen Genehmigungs-, Zulassungs- oder Regulierungsprojekten und kannst rechtliche, technische und behördliche Anforderungen sicher zusammenführen

  • Du verfügst über einen fachlichen Hintergrund, der dich zu detaillierter und fundierter Arbeit an technischen, rechtlichen und behördlichen Fragestellungen befähigt, zum Beispiel in Luftfahrt, Ingenieurwesen, Recht, Verwaltung, Sicherheitsmanagement oder einem vergleichbaren Bereich

  • Du kannst komplexe Vorgaben selbstständig prüfen, sauber dokumentieren und gegenüber Kunden sowie Behörden nachvollziehbar vertreten

  • Du hast Erfahrung in der Planung und Organisation von Trainings, Schulungen oder vergleichbaren wiederkehrenden Formaten und kannst Inhalte sicher vor Gruppen vermitteln

  • Du arbeitest sehr sorgfältig, analytisch und eigenständig und kommunizierst schriftlich wie mündlich klar und verbindlich auf Deutsch

Womit du zusätzlich punktest

  • Kenntnisse im europäischen Drohnenrecht sowie zur Betriebskategorie „speziell“, zu SORA, PDRA oder Flugrisikobewertungen

  • Erfahrung in der Zusammenarbeit mit Landes- und regionalen Luftfahrtbehörden

  • Praktische Erfahrung mit professionellen Drohneneinsätzen, etwa Inspektionen, Vermessungen oder Filmaufnahmen

  • Erfahrung als Trainer oder in der fachlichen Weiterbildung von Erwachsenen

Arbeitsort und Umfang

Die Position kann in Bielefeld oder remote innerhalb Deutschlands ausgeübt werden. Für einzelne Teamabstimmungen, Schulungen, Workshops oder Projekttermine ist Präsenz in Bielefeld oder beim Kunden erforderlich. Möglich sind Vollzeit und Teilzeit.

Deine Bewerbung

Wir möchten verstehen, wie du technische, rechtliche und behördliche Anforderungen fundiert zusammenführst und wie du unsere Kunden und regelmäßig stattfindenden Trainings zuverlässig betreust. Bitte füge deiner Bewerbung Folgendes bei:

  • Einen prägnanten Lebenslauf

  • Ein paar Sätze zu deinem fachlichen Hintergrund und deiner Erfahrung mit Genehmigungs-, Zulassungs- oder Regulierungsprojekten

  • Ein kurzes Beispiel für ein komplexes Vorhaben oder ein Training, das du geplant, geprüft oder begleitet hast

  • Deinen möglichen Starttermin und deinen gewünschten Stundenumfang

Über uns

Cléo Public Relations ist eine inhabergeführte PR-Agentur in Hamburg. Über 100 CEOs haben wir bereits in der Presse, auf Bühnen und in der Öffentlichkeit positioniert – für Start-ups, Scale-ups und VCs aus Food, Health, Interior, Beauty, Tech & Finance. Bei den PR Report Awards 2026 wurden wir in der Kategorie CEO-Kommunikation unter die Top 5 „Best in Class“ gewählt.

Unsere Kund:innen verstehen uns als Sparringspartner auf Augenhöhe. Sie wollen sich als Thought Leader in ihrer Branche klar positionieren und ihre Expertise durch öffentliche Auftritte und Meinungsbildung sichtbar machen.

Wir arbeiten nah an unseren Kund:innen, mit kurzen Wegen und viel Eigenverantwortung im Team.

Die Rolle

Wir suchen ab sofort eine Manager:in Personal Branding & CEO-Kommunikation (m/w/d) in Vollzeit in Hamburg. Du verantwortest Personal Branding und CEO-Kommunikation für Gründer:innen und Geschäftsführer:innen unserer Kund:innen – auf LinkedIn, in den Medien und auf Bühnen.

Du bist Sparringspartner:in von Foundern, findest ihre Themen und ihre Stimme und sorgst dafür, dass sie sichtbar werden.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Du leitest Kick-off-Strategieworkshops, analysierst, wie Founder und CEOs heute wahrgenommen werden, vergleichst sie mit relevanten Wettbewerber:innen und entwickelst mit ihnen ihre Soll-Positionierung: Kernthemen, Tonalität, Kanäle, Formate.

  • Du optimierst LinkedIn-Profile, schreibst Beiträge im Namen von Foundern nach einem gemeinsamen Style Guide, planst Redaktionskalender und übernimmst das Community Management.

  • Du entwickelst Instagram-Strategien und Content-Ideen für Founder.

  • Du konzipierst Fotoshootings und begleitest sie vor Ort.

  • Du führst Interviews mit Foundern, um Themen, Haltungen und Geschichten herauszuarbeiten, die zu ihrer Positionierung und zur Unternehmensstory passen.

  • Du platzierst sie in Medien, Podcasts und auf Panels – gemeinsam mit unserem PR-Team.

  • Du vernetzt Founder über das Cléo-Netzwerk mit Journalist:innen, Meinungsführer:innen und Investor:innen und öffnest Türen zu ausgewählten Branchen-Events.

  • Du bereitest sie auf Interviews, Vorträge und Videoformate vor (Briefings, Kernbotschaften) und organisierst bei Bedarf Medientrainings.

  • Du wertest Reichweite und Resonanz aus und leitest daraus nächste Schritte ab.

  • Du bist feste Sparringspartner:in von Foundern, mit regelmäßigen Abstimmungen, ehrlichem Feedback und Unterstützung in der Krisenkommunikation, und arbeitest eng mit den jeweiligen Account-Teams zusammen.

Was du mitbringst

  • 2–4 Jahre Erfahrung in PR, Corporate Communications, Content oder Journalismus – idealerweise mit Fokus auf Executive oder Founder Communications.

  • Du schreibst sehr gut auf Deutsch und gut auf Englisch und kannst dich in fremde Stimmen hineinversetzen.

  • Du kennst LinkedIn als Plattform genau: Formate, Algorithmus, was funktioniert und was nicht.

  • Du hast ein Gespür für Themen und Geschichten und erkennst, was eine Person relevant macht.

  • Du trittst souverän gegenüber Gründer:innen und Geschäftsführer:innen auf und gibst auch kritisches Feedback.

  • Du arbeitest strukturiert und behältst mehrere Kund:innen gleichzeitig im Blick.

  • Gut zu haben: Netzwerk zu Redaktionen, Podcasts oder Veranstaltern.

Was wir bieten

  • Spannende Founder und Marken aus unterschiedlichen Branchen, von Startup bis Mittelstand.

  • Ein kleines Team mit kurzen Wegen und direktem Austausch mit der Geschäftsführung.

  • Raum, das Thema Personal Branding bei Cléo aktiv mitzugestalten.

  • Ein Büro in Hamburg und Homeoffice nach Absprache.

  • Gleitzeit, 30 Tage Urlaub, betriebliche Altersvorsorge und Weiterbildung.

Bewerbung

Schick uns deinen Lebenslauf, zwei bis drei Arbeitsproben (gern LinkedIn-Beiträge, die du für andere geschrieben hast) und sag uns in ein paar Sätzen, welche Founder-Persönlichkeit du gern positionieren würdest und warum.

Team description

SumUp's Hardware Development team builds the physical products millions of small businesses rely on every day, and this role sits right at the start of a new chapter: moving our in-house hardware onto the Android platform for the first time. This isn't a typical Android device, it's a highly customised, security-first product built from scratch, which means the person joining will help define how the operating system, drivers, and secure processor come together rather than inheriting someone else's setup. The team works closely with hardware, software, and QA engineers across the bring-up process, so this role offers a rare chance to shape a product's foundations while working alongside experienced embedded and secure processor leads.

Please note this role would require relocation to Berlin, Germany.

What you'll do

  • Support system bring-up for the new Android embedded platform, from bootloader through to kernel and framework
  • Integrate and maintain kernel modules and drivers, including power management and connectivity components
  • Contribute to build system integration across the platform
  • Debug hardware and software issues at the protocol level and help resolve critical issues found during testing
  • Carry out testing and validation to confirm the platform is stable and secure before release

You'll be great for this role if…

  • Experience developing embedded systems with a strong focus on Android OS, gained over several years in a professional setting
  • Strong knowledge of the Android OS architecture, from bootloader (U-Boot, Little Kernel) and kernel through to framework and services
  • Hands-on experience debugging hardware interfaces at protocol level, including I2C, SPI, UART, and SDIO
  • Solid understanding of embedded security concepts such as Secure Boot, TrustZone (TEE), dm-verity, encryption, and hardware-backed key storage
  • Comfort working with Qualcomm Snapdragon or MediaTek platforms, and expert-level C programming for embedded Linux environments

You'll join one of the teams within SumUp's Identity Lifecycle Mission, working on some of the most critical building blocks behind the merchant journey, from onboarding and identity verification to KYC/KYB, regulatory data collection, and managing customer identity throughout the entire lifecycle.

Today, many of these capabilities live across different flows, legacy services, and tightly coupled integrations. We're on a journey to bring these pieces together into a more coherent, scalable platform, with shared data models, reusable services, and clear ownership boundaries.

As a Senior Backend Engineer, you won't just be maintaining existing systems. You'll have the opportunity to shape how our identity platform evolves, modernise critical services, and help build foundations that can support new regulations, markets, and product requirements without reinventing the wheel every time.

You'll be part of one dedicated team, but the challenges we tackle often cross team and domain boundaries. You'll work closely with Engineers, Product, Design, Compliance, Risk, and Operations, giving you the opportunity to influence solutions well beyond your own team.

If you enjoy solving complex backend problems, working in a highly collaborative environment, improving reliability, and building scalable capabilities that enable other teams to move faster, this could be an exciting opportunity to make a real impact at SumUp.

About Wolt

At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we're building the delivery of (almost) everything and you'll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe.

Working at Wolt isn't always easy, but it's definitely exciting. Here you'll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You'll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you're a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life.

Senior Sales Regional Enterprise Manager

At Wolt, we create technology that brings local communities, merchants and customers closer together. What started with restaurant delivery has grown into a broader local commerce platform, helping customers discover and access more of what their cities have to offer.

As our Retail business continues to grow, we're looking for a Senior Sales Regional Enterprise Manager to expand our selection of high-value regional retail partners. You'll join our Sales team and take ownership of some of the most important regional acquisition opportunities across priority retail verticals, helping shape what customers can find on Wolt in their cities. This role can be based in Berlin, Cologne, Frankfurt, Hamburg or Munich .

What you'll be doing

In this role, you'll own the acquisition and development of high-value regional Enterprise retail partners in Germany, from identifying and engaging the right prospects through commercial negotiations, signing and initial rollout. You'll combine strong commercial execution with a strategic view on which partners can have the greatest impact on Wolt's selection, coverage and long-term growth.

Day-to-day in this role you'll:

  • Own the end-to-end sales cycle for regional Enterprise retail opportunities, from prospecting and qualification through negotiation, contracting and signing.
  • Build and manage a high-quality pipeline of larger regional retailers and multi-location partners across priority verticals such as grocery, convenience, pet, pharmacy and beauty.
  • Develop a deep understanding of prospective partners' businesses and create compelling commercial propositions that demonstrate the value of partnering with Wolt.
  • Lead complex commercial negotiations, balancing partner needs with sustainable economics and Wolt's long-term business objectives.
  • Build strong relationships with senior decision-makers and act as a trusted commercial partner throughout the sales process.
  • Work closely with internal teams including Operations, Account Management, Finance, Legal, Marketing and Product to structure partnerships and enable successful launches.
  • Take ownership beyond the signature, ensuring a strong handover and initial rollout so that newly acquired partners can successfully go live and scale.
  • Use market insights, pipeline data and commercial learnings to identify opportunities, prioritize the highest-impact accounts and continuously improve our regional Enterprise sales approach.
  • Contribute to sharing best practices and raising the bar for Enterprise sales execution across the wider team.

Our humble expectations

  • You have significant experience in B2B sales, business development or strategic partnerships, ideally working with Enterprise or other complex, multi-stakeholder customers.
  • You have a strong track record of independently managing and closing complex commercial opportunities from initial outreach through contract signature.
  • You're an excellent negotiator and understand how to build partnerships that create sustainable value for both sides.
  • You're comfortable engaging and influencing senior stakeholders, both externally and across cross-functional internal teams.
  • You combine a hands-on, results-oriented sales mindset with strong commercial judgment and the ability to prioritize opportunities based on their strategic impact.
  • You're highly structured and comfortable managing multiple opportunities and stakeholders simultaneously while maintaining strong attention to detail.
  • You're comfortable working with data and commercial metrics to evaluate opportunities, build business cases and inform decisions.
  • You communicate clearly and persuasively and are fluent in German and English. 

What we offer

This is an opportunity to play a meaningful role in the next phase of Wolt's Retail growth. You'll have direct ownership of high-impact regional partnerships and the autonomy to take opportunities from first conversation all the way through to launch.

You'll work at the intersection of sales, strategy and operations, collaborating with experienced colleagues across Wolt while building relationships with some of the most important retailers in the market. The role offers substantial commercial ownership and exposure while giving you the opportunity to develop further in Enterprise sales and contribute to how we scale our Retail business.

You'll also join a fast-moving international environment where good ideas can quickly turn into action, with the tools, support and trust to take ownership of your work and make a visible impact.

Next steps

If this sounds like an opportunity you'd be excited about, we'd love to hear from you.

After you apply, our Talent Acquisition team will review your application and get in touch with selected candidates for an initial conversation. The process will typically include interviews with the hiring team and relevant stakeholders, giving you the opportunity to learn more about the role, team and business while we get to know your experience and approach.

Depending on the role and location, the process may also include a practical case or commercial exercise. We'll share the exact interview steps and expectations with you as you progress through the process.

Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion

We're committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That's why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel.

Beware of recruitment scams: DoorDash, Deliveroo, and Wolt will never ask you to pay money or share sensitive financial information during hiring — learn more about our legitimate recruiting process at Recruitment Scam Awareness - DoorDash .

Our dedication to remote-first work, and strong culture of connection and global inclusion means that no matter your location, you’re part of a vibrant team with diverse experiences making a global impact each day. As we continue to revolutionize how the world interacts, we’re acquiring new skills and experiences that make work feel truly rewarding. Your career at Twilio is in your hands.
.

Hiring and how we work

Also, while we are a remote-first company, you may be asked to report in person on an ad-hoc basis for team gatherings, functional off-sites or customer meetings.

Join the team as Twilio’s next New Business Account Executive.

You will play a key role in further growing Twilio’s Communication Products business across Southern Europe. You will be responsible for sourcing new, high value customers as well as driving the sales process from internal leads to qualifying new prospects and handling deals to closure.

  • Master creating pricing proposals, negotiating terms and managing the contract process. Ideally, you also have experience selling communications to a technical and business audience, building trust and mutual respect with technical customers and peers.

Qualifications

Your Next Destination

About The Role

You will own a complex domain of the Network business support systems (BSS) stack as a strategic product area with users, measurable outcomes, technical dependencies, and cross-functional impact. You will define the roadmap, shape the technical direction with engineering and architecture partners, and lead discovery and execution across multiple squads and stakeholder groups.

What You'll Do

  • Own a BSS domain's strategy and roadmap, linking quarterly outcomes to platform evolution, commercial strategy, regulation, scalability and architecture.
  • Lead discovery for complex BSS and network-platform problems: frame problems, research stakeholders, analyse operations and market and regulatory inputs, and validate solution options.
  • Turn ambiguous business, commercial, regulatory and technical needs into product opportunities, decision records and actionable roadmap bets.
  • Sequence launch-blocking market needs, incumbent-platform migrations, cost reduction and enabling capabilities; publish the rationale.
  • Define and optimise metrics and KPIs to measure impact, report status and inform decisions.
  • Own the network-capability interface with Commercial and Partnerships: assess wholesale agreements and international mobile subscriber identity (IMSI) sponsorships, their technical benefits and constraints, and which asks warrant reopening a contract.
  • Write engineering specifications covering the problem, current and target behaviour, interface contracts, migration, rollback and observable acceptance criteria.
  • Lead cross-squad delivery through epics, product requirements documents, migration plans, acceptance criteria, dependency maps, release sequencing, rollout and rollback plans, and success metrics.
  • Resolve cross-squad trade-offs and conflicting views of dependencies; document the disagreement and resolution.
  • Brief senior leaders in plain language on changes, costs, benefits, risks, trade-offs and decisions needed, with analysis and technical detail available.
  • Partner with Engineering and Solution Architecture to evaluate technical approaches, platform trade-offs, integration patterns, migration, rollback and long-term maintainability.
  • Influence architecture by clarifying product outcomes, operational constraints, regulatory and data requirements, and customer and partner impact.

  • Experience with agile / scrum methodology.

  • Knowledge of eSIM, Global System for Mobile Communications (GSM) and MNO / MVNO / MVNE operating models.

Get to Know Us

Horizon3.ai is a fast-growing, remote cybersecurity company dedicated to the mission of enabling organizations to proactively find, fix and verify exploitable attack vectors before criminals exploit them. Our flagship product, the NodeZeroTM platform, delivers production-safe autonomous pentests and other key assessment operations that scale across the largest internal, external, cloud, and hybrid cloud environments. We are a fusion of former U.S. Special Operations cyber operators, startup engineers & operators, and formerly frustrated cybersecurity practitioners. We're committed to helping solve our common security problems: ineffective security tools and false positives, resulting in alert fatigue, blind spots, "checkbox” security culture, cybersecurity skills shortage, and the long lead time and expense of hiring outside consultants. Collectively, we are a team of learn-it-alls, committed to a culture of respect, collaboration, ownership, and results.

What You’ll Do

We are seeking a UK-based Enterprise Technical Support Engineer with 5+ years of hands-on industry experience to join our high-performing support team. In this role, you will serve as a key technical resource for our enterprise customers, diagnosing and resolving complex issues related to cloud infrastructure, networking, and security. You'll collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure seamless customer experiences, leveraging your expertise in Linux, containerization, and cloud technologies. This position requires a proactive self-learner who thrives in fast-paced enterprise environments and can handle escalated support tickets with minimal supervision.

Key Responsibilities

  • Collaborate with engineering, product, and sales teams to escalate and resolve intricate technical challenges, while documenting solutions for knowledge sharing.

  • Assist in the deployment and optimization of customer environments, offering guidance on best practices for infrastructure as code (IaC) and containerized applications.

  • Monitor and respond to support tickets in a timely manner, maintaining SLAs and contributing to continuous improvement of support processes.

  • Mentor junior team members and contribute to internal training resources, fostering a culture of knowledge transfer and technical excellence.

  • Stay abreast of emerging technologies and industry trends to enhance support capabilities and customer satisfaction.

Build a Safer World.

TRM Labs provides AI-powered intelligence solutions that help public and private sector agencies investigate and disrupt crime. TRM's platforms enable investigators to trace illicit activity, build cases, and construct operating pictures of threat networks. Leading agencies and businesses worldwide rely on TRM to make the world safer and more secure.

As a Solutions Architect on TRM's Onchain Compliance - EMEA team, you are the technical owner of the sales cycle for crypto exchanges, banks, fintechs, and payments companies. You partner with Account Directors from the first discovery call through close, then stay close as customers integrate and go live. You turn a compliance team's requirements into an architecture they trust and a pilot that proves it.

The impact you will have:

  • Own the technical win on strategic onchain compliance deals, using TRM's platform and AI-assisted workflows to turn each customer's compliance process into an architecture they trust. This directly determines whether TRM lands and keeps tier 1 accounts.

  • Compress time to value by building tailored, AI-assisted demos within days of discovery, showing compliance teams how TRM plus AI cuts manual alert review.

  • Design and prove API integrations that fit real compliance operations, including alert triage, case management, and escalation, and use AI tooling to prototype them quickly.

  • Build reusable, AI-enabled demo and integration assets so every deal moves faster than the last and the team scales without adding manual work.

  • Feed field insight back to Product and Engineering, shaping the roadmap so TRM stays ahead of what compliance teams need next.

What we’re looking for:

  • 5+ years in pre- and post-sales technical roles (Solutions Architect, Sales Engineer, Solutions Engineer, or Customer Success Engineer), increasingly using AI tools in your workflow.

  • Hands-on experience scoping, implementing, and supporting API-based SaaS integrations, including using AI to prototype and test them faster.

  • Comfort with REST APIs and scripting in Python, JavaScript, or TypeScript, and with AI coding assistants to build quick prototypes.

  • Familiarity with AML, KYC, sanctions screening, or transaction monitoring, and interest in applying AI to speed compliance review.

  • Daily use of AI tools with the judgment to know when to trust the output and when to verify it.

  • Strong discovery, prioritization across several opportunities at once, and clear communication with both engineers and senior compliance leaders.

  • Bonus: blockchain fundamentals, crypto compliance regulation, or experience building AI-enabled workflows. If you are excited by the mission but do not check every box, we encourage you to apply.

About the Team:

  • Solutions Architecture at TRM is a globally distributed, fully remote team that works asynchronously through Slack and detailed documentation.

  • The team is on the front lines of TRM: trusted technical advisors to customers and a primary source of customer insight for Product and Engineering.

  • The work is intellectually demanding. You translate complex compliance and blockchain problems into clear solutions under real deal pressure.

  • Expect high ownership and pace. You run your opportunities end to end and are trusted to make the technical call.

Team Operating Rhythms:

  • Weekly customer syncs, bi-weekly health syncs, and account POD calls, with regular direct customer engagement.

  • Async-first communication through Slack and written documentation. Distributed, not distant.

  • Travel 20 to 30 percent for customer meetings and onsite sessions.

On-Call Responsibilities:

  • Schedule: No formal on-call rotation.

  • Frequency: Occasional off-hours escalations for live customer incidents (HM to confirm at intake).

Travel Requirements:

  • Schedule: As needed for customer meetings and onsite sessions.

  • Frequency: 20 to 30 percent.

Onsite Requirements:

  • Schedule: Occasional customer onsite visits.

  • Frequency: HM to confirm at intake.

Learn about TRM Speed in this position:

  • Within days of discovery, you put a demo built around the customer's compliance workflow in front of them, not a generic walkthrough.

  • Within days of a customer's commitment, you have agreed success criteria and a live pilot environment.

  • In the first 90 days, you build reusable demo and integration assets that cut setup time on the next deal.

Application Instructions

If you’re interested in joining TRM, we encourage you to apply directly. Every application is reviewed by our Talent team.

Before applying, review the job description carefully and highlight the experience and impact that best demonstrate the required qualifications. Please also provide thoughtful and accurate answers to the application questions, as these will be used to evaluate your skills and qualifications for the role.

If you send your resume directly to someone at TRM, we can’t guarantee it will reach the appropriate hiring team. Applying directly is the best way to ensure your application will be considered.

Interviewing with TRM

Our process is designed to understand how you think, solve problems, and deliver impact, while allowing you to evaluate TRM. Most interview processes include a case study, an AI skills assessment, and a Leadership Principles interview.

  • Recruiter Intro: Qualifications, motivations, and alignment with the role.

  • Hiring Manager: Deep dive into your relevant experience, skills, and impact.

  • First Round: 1–2 interviews focused on the skills most critical to the role.

  • Final Round: Hands-on case study. This is usually a panel-style session where we go deeper into your craft, problem-solving, and alignment with TRM.

  • References: Former colleagues who can provide insight into your work and impact.

  • Offer: Congrats! Your recruiter will present the offer and compensation details.

  • Welcome to TRM: We're excited to build a safer world with you!

Your recruiter will share your specific interview plan and preparation guidance along the way.

AI Fluency at TRM

AI fluency is a baseline expectation at TRM.

We believe AI meaningfully changes how top performers operate. We expect every team member to use AI to accelerate and reimagine their craft, not just automate surface tasks.

At TRM, AI fluency means you are among the top 10 percent of operators in your function in how you apply AI to:

  • Accelerate repeatable workflows

  • Structure and solve problems

  • Improve output quality

  • Increase speed and leverage

You will be evaluated on applied AI fluency during the interview process.

Life at TRM

We are building a safer world. That promise shows up in how we work every day.

TRM moves FAST. We are a high-velocity, high-ownership team that expects clarity, follow-through, and impact. People who thrive here are energized by hard problems, experimentation, and continuous feedback. If something takes months elsewhere, it will ship here in days.

Our work sits at the intersection of AI, national security, and fighting crime. The problems are complex, the stakes are real, and the environment evolves quickly. The pace and intensity of the work reflect the importance of the mission. As a result, the way we operate requires a high level of ownership, adaptability, collaboration, and creative problem-solving.

At TRM, you should expect:

  • Priorities and targets to change quickly

  • Operating with a high degree of ambiguity

  • A high level of personal ownership and accountability

  • Close collaboration across teams and functions

  • Frequent, high-touch communication

  • Creative problem-solving and out-of-the-box thinking

  • A pace that rewards urgency, adaptability, and outcomes

This environment is energizing for people who enjoy building, solving hard problems, and making progress in situations that are not always fully defined. It also requires thriving in ambiguity, adjusting course as new information emerges, and maintaining focus and positivity in a fast-moving and intense environment.

We also recognize that this style of operating is not for everyone. If you are primarily optimizing for predictability or a consistently balanced workload, we encourage you to use the interview process to pressure-test whether this environment is truly the right fit. We want teammates who thrive here, not just survive here.

If you are excited by meaningful problems, motivated by ambitious goals, and energized by working alongside mission-driven colleagues, there is a good chance you will find TRM to be an exceptional place to grow and contribute.

Leadership Principles

We hire and grow against three leadership principles. They’re the standards for how we operate, treat each other, and make decisions.

  • Impact-Oriented Trailblazer: We put customers first and move with speed, focus, and adaptability. We treat every plan like an experiment – test, ship, measure, and iterate quickly.

  • Master Craftsperson: We care deeply about our craft. We balance speed with high standards, own outcomes end‑to‑end, and invest in getting better everyday.

  • Inspiring Colleague: We add clarity and energy, not noise. We bring humility, candor, and a one‑team mindset — giving and receiving feedback to make the team stronger.

Join our Mission

At TRM, we care deeply about our craft. We are looking for individuals who want their work to matter, who experiment with speed and rigor, and who take pride in building a safer world for billions of people. If you’re excited by TRM’s mission but don’t check every box, we encourage you to apply — we hire for slope, judgment, and the will to learn fast.

TRM is a Series C company with $220M in total funding, backed by Goldman Sachs, Bessemer, Y Combinator, Thoma Bravo, and others. Headquartered in San Francisco, TRM operates as a distributed-first company with hubs in Los Angeles, San Francisco, New York, Washington D.C., London, and Singapore.

  • Own and execute territory and account plans to deliver revenue targets, growing existing customers into additional teams, buying centres and use cases, with Dropbox Core as the primary product.

Help Build the Next Chapter of Product Development at Fresh Prints

Hi, I’m Andy, the Product Development Manager at Fresh Prints.

Before Fresh Prints, I spent five years with a national fashion retail group in the Philippines, working my way from graphic designer to creative lead. When I joined Fresh Prints as a graphic designer in September 2024, I wanted to focus on designing again. Building a department wasn’t exactly the plan.

I was thrown into it pretty quickly. I’d expected to be designing email newsletters. Within my first month, I was in China meeting manufacturers and sourcing fabrics. Soon after, I became the first dedicated person in Product Development, figuring out how to build the function from the ground up.

Fresh Prints already had successful garments, but there was no established playbook for the department. I worked across Creative and Logistics, built our tech pack template, mapped development timelines, and brought in technical support. Together with the wider team, we expanded beyond a single supplier and launched products like our mock neck, which has sold over 40,000 units in less than two years.

I also had to learn what American college students wanted. Through our Fashion Council conversations, I learned to push past “that’s cute.” Was it the fit, fabric, or color? Would they actually buy it? Those answers shaped our products. Clear specs, careful sample reviews, and consistent follow-through helped bring them to life.

That’s what I value about working here. You can question a process, propose something better, and take responsibility for making it happen. My role grew because there was room to contribute beyond what I was hired to do.

Now, we’re looking for a Technical Fashion Designer who enjoys the technical side of bringing garments to life. Someone who cares about the details, catches inconsistencies, and thinks about how their work affects the next person in the process:

  • Can a supplier follow these specs without guessing?
  • Do the sample, tech pack, art proof, and website information agree?
  • What needs to be resolved before this moves into production?

If you enjoy solving problems, getting the details right, and seeing your work become something people wear, I’d love to hear from you.

Key Responsibilities

You’ll work closely with our Product Development Team Lead to turn product ideas and revisions into clear, accurate technical information. Your day-to-day work will include:

  • Create and update tech packs for assigned new products, existing garment revisions, and Collab or client requests, including measurements, construction details, and fabric specifications.
  • Review samples and document feedback, including QA findings, technical issues, and required revisions.
  • Check art proofs and briefs for garment accuracy, print compatibility, and production limitations.
  • Support supplier development by preparing technical specifications, reviewing supplier submissions, and coordinating follow-ups with suppliers and internal teams.
  • Keep product information accurate across technical records and website descriptions, specifications, colorways, and imagery.
  • Support new product development through tasks assigned by the Team Lead, flagging missing information, discrepancies, and potential production issues.

Your focus is to make sure other teams have complete, accurate product information they can confidently use.

Key Skills & Personal Attributes:

  • Commercial awareness and ability to execute within defined brand and market direction.

  • Advanced Adobe Illustrator skills (print design + garment CADs).

  • Working knowledge of Adobe Photoshop.

  • Strong understanding of garment construction, materials, and fit.

  • Confident English communication for factory and cross-team coordination.

  • Highly detail-oriented with strong ownership of documentation and QA accuracy.

Qualifications:

  • 3 to 5 years of experience in fashion design, apparel technical design, or product development.
  • Proven experience creating prints, CADs, and production-ready tech packs for apparel.
  • Experience communicating with manufacturers and managing sampling revisions.
  • Portfolio showcasing printed garments and technical design work (CADs + tech packs required).
  • Strong organization skills with clear production and timeline awareness.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Fashion Design, Apparel Design, or a related field preferred.

Monthly Salary: $700 - $900 (adjusted for experience) + $40 Night Shift Allowance

Who We Are

Oportun (Nasdaq: OPRT) is a mission-driven financial services company that puts its members' financial goals within reach. Since inception, Oportun has provided more than $22.7 billion in responsible and affordable credit, saved its members more than $2.5 billion in interest and fees, and helped its members set aside an average of more than $1,800 annually.

The Opportunity

The Senior Financial Analyst is a key member of the Financial Planning & Analysis team, partnering closely with C-level executives and business leaders to set financial and operational goals and budgets, track performance, and translate results into actionable insights. This role connects financial and operational information across the organization, ensuring the right stakeholders have the context they need to make timely, informed decisions. Success means delivering rigorous forecasts and analysis while helping drive ownership, accountability, and follow-through against Oportun’s financial and strategic objectives.

At Oportun, we move fast and we hold each other to a high bar. If you care about doing your best work while actually moving the needle for real people, you'll fit right in.

What You'll Do

Your day-to-day

  • Partner with C-level executives and business leaders to develop financial goals, budgets, and forecasts, and track performance against those commitments.
  • Produce monthly and multi-year financial forecasts that provide a clear view of expected performance and support company planning.
  • Analyze P&L performance, explain variances to plan, identify current and emerging trends, and surface risks and opportunities.
  • Perform financial, cost/benefit, and other ad-hoc analyses to support executive decision-making and strategic initiatives.
  • Manage recurring financial and KPI reporting, including clear, decision-ready materials for executives and other key stakeholders.
  • Drive ownership and accountability across the organization by establishing clear financial goals, tracking performance, and ensuring stakeholders understand commitments, risks, and required actions.
  • Connect insights across financial and operational data, identifying relationships and emerging themes and bringing them to the right stakeholders to enable timely, informed decision-making.
  • Bring ideas for how we can do things better—proactively, not just when asked—and look for thoughtful ways to use AI tools to reduce manual work and improve decision-making.

Who You Are

The right fit looks like this

You’re an intellectually curious, proactive finance professional who enjoys connecting the dots and turning complex information into clear, actionable insights. You combine strong analytical skills and attention to detail with excellent interpersonal skills, allowing you to build credibility and work effectively with stakeholders at all levels, including C-level executives.

You’re comfortable navigating ambiguity, challenging assumptions, and moving forward without perfect information. You communicate clearly, exercise sound judgment, and have the confidence to surface risks, opportunities, and differing perspectives when they matter.

We build with AI. We lead with judgment.
